finding.problem: name_release has no check on release_name. An empty string is accepted and would blank an existing name. The same name can be given to two commits, and the owner can rename a commit at will, so "Spring" may point to different commits over time. The change exists so people can refer to a release by name instead of by commit id, and these gaps defeat that. Skip_stage, by contrast, has a `reason-given` non-empty check.

findings.label: false-alarm
findings.why: The request only asked for the owner to name an approved commit; empty-name, duplicate-name and rename concerns are speculative requirements beyond the request, not a real defect in this change.

edit.why: It adds a release_name field on Commit, an owner-only name_release action with an approved precondition, transitions, and examples, covering naming an approved commit.
